Inge Mølgaard is a patient representative who has served on the steering committee of AFDK, the Danish national quality database for atrial fibrillation treatment [^src1][^src2]. She is named in the steering group listings of two consecutive AFDK annual reports: the 2023 report covering the period 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023 [^src1], and the 2024 report [^src2]. In both, she is identified with the title "Patientrepræsentant" (patient representative) [^src1][^src2].

The 2024 report section in which she appears also documents patient representatives' perspectives on structured patient education, describes how Hospitalsenhed Midt has implemented systematic patient education since 2012, and outlines the steering committee's membership alongside key methodological limitations of the database [^src2]. This places her role within AFDK's broader mission as a nationwide quality database operating under the Danish Society of Cardiology and approved by the Danish Health Authority [^src2].

No further biographical details, relationships, or claims about Inge Mølgaard are available in the corpus.
